cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(rosplus_cpp_validation)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
add_executable(cpp_processor ../../../ros2_cpp/cpp_processor.cpp)
ament_target_dependencies(cpp_processor rclcpp std_msgs)
install(TARGETS cpp_processor DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
ament_package()
